acceptance_criteria.text: The catalogue schema reference documents the supported declaration spelling for trait implementations with lifetime arguments, including the distinct lifetime notation used in the trait reference and implementation-generics declaration.

The catalogue schema reference identifies entry-level methods as the normal inherent-method declaration location, reserves top-level inherent-implementation declarations for entry-level limitations, and documents the currently matchable single trailing private tuple-field form.
The catalogue DTO documentation for implementation generics no longer states that lifetimes are outside the supported surface and instead aligns with the schema reference's lifetime declaration rule.
Structural matching assigns a positional key only to a tuple-struct or tuple-variant field item; a child originating from an inherent implementation receives no positional suffix.
A catalogue fixture with exactly one trailing private tuple field and an inherent method declared through a top-level inherent-implementation entry evaluates blue.
Previously blue structural-matching verdicts remain blue; the only changed verdict class is the combination of a tuple struct, a private field, and an inherent implementation.

constraints.text: The declaration guidance and DTO documentation alignment do not change runtime behaviour.

Top-level inherent-implementation declarations remain supported for cases that cannot be expressed through an entry's methods; the guidance must not turn their use into an unsupported declaration form.
The positional-key decision is determined by the child item's field identity rather than by comparing its position with the number of fields.
The existing codec representation of one trailing private tuple field remains unchanged.

goal.text: Make supported catalogue declarations discoverable and make structural matching consistently recognize their field and inherent-implementation children.

in_scope.text: Document the supported lifetime trait-implementation spelling, inherent-method placement guidance, and private tuple-field matching limitation in the catalogue schema reference.
Align implementation-generics documentation in the catalogue DTO surface with the supported lifetime declaration guidance.
Restrict structural-matching positional keys to tuple field children, leaving inherent-implementation-derived children unnumbered.
Add regression coverage for the matchable one-trailing-private-tuple-field form when its inherent method is declared through a top-level inherent-implementation entry.

out_of_scope.text: Supporting structural matching for tuple structs with two or more private fields or with a private field before a public field.
Changing the codec's single-trailing-private-field None encoding.

title: Catalogue schema declaration guidance and field-only positional keys
